execution: unexecuted behavioral/failure source fixtures; no native program or extraction executed

cases.name: role-ownership
cases.expect: medium/full desktops and server DevOps include os.firmware; base and CI/DNS-only roles do not

cases.name: desktop-only-login-and-gui
cases.expect: only medium/full desktop classes select desktop.ch341a; no skel-desktop or graphical command validation on server

cases.name: restricted-pinned-policy
cases.expect: reject duplicate JSON keys, unpinned commit, moving URL, unsupported host, invalid digest or reversed byte bounds before acquisition

cases.name: redirect-before-request
cases.expect: shared HTTP owner validates every redirect before requesting it; HTTPS and total transport deadline remain bounded

cases.name: header-resource-bound
cases.expect: member count, declared expanded total, individual size, PAX extension aggregate and long path limits apply before payload allocation

cases.name: path-and-type
cases.expect: reject absolute/dot/dotdot/duplicate/foreign-root paths, symlinks, hardlinks, devices and sparse entries; never run tar extraction or package scripts

cases.name: pax-bomb
cases.expect: oversized PAX/GNU extension or inconsistent record length refuses before allocation

cases.name: elf-and-digests
cases.expect: source digest, required members, selected binary digest and amd64 ELF identity all match before publishing

cases.name: source-and-license
cases.expect: complete immutable release keeps pinned source archive, license, readme, flash support list and policy metadata

cases.name: concurrency
cases.expect: same ownership lock guards install and cleanup; a second writer cannot replace existing release or stable command

cases.name: uncertain-child
cases.expect: retained private acquisition and pending marker; status76 and no same-boot automatic retry or numeric PID fallback

cases.name: recovery
cases.expect: explicit recovery requires a different boot and the exact owned workspace; releases and other files survive

cases.name: entrypoint-competition
cases.expect: refuse a pre-existing unmanaged executable or differing stable symlink

cases.name: final-identity
cases.expect: published executable bytes match approved binary SHA256 without executing the program

cases.name: no-hardware
cases.expect: installation stages CLI/workspace/udev rules only; no selected programmer or firmware mutation executes
